title: Playable web app. Shoots some hoops. Hear the breeze. Relax. That's it.
author: Brilliant-Brick9047
selftext:
A playable web app that provides a moment of disconnect and relax while shooting some hoops. It is aimed at helping people that have an anxiety attack and need a distraction for the first few moments of the experiences. If you use some headphones you can hear an immersive seaside atmosphere. No sign ups or any friction layer... no other point except shooting hoops.  
[https://hooptherapy.psycurate.com](https://hooptherapy.psycurate.com/)

  
I used a background image and a three.js 3D infrastructure on top. Everything done in Google AI Studio.

comments.author: who-are-u
comments.body: Thanks for making the app.  I like what you are doing with your website as well with the other wellness apps.  I'm also dedicated to creating simple privacy free apps that aren't full of distractions.  Keep it up!

replies.author: Brilliant-Brick9047
replies.body: thank you my friend. If you ever make a tool that can help alleviate psychological tension in any way and decide to make it free you can add it to the directory if you want. Peace!
